title: Experience Designer I (UX/UI)
note: Early-career UX/UI role at a product design consultancy; asks for about 2 years of experience and welcomes interaction, graphic or industrial design degrees.

facts.duties: User research and synthesis, flows and wireframes, AI-assisted prototypes and usability tests, visual UI polish, motion and design systems, working alongside industrial designers and engineers.
facts.requirements: 2-3 years of UX/UI work; degree in interaction, HCI, graphic, industrial design or similar; strong visual craft; Figma fluency; portfolio showing process. Hybrid with 3 days a week in the SF studio.
facts.apply: Apply with a resume through the form on the posting page; candidates who don't meet every requirement are encouraged to apply.
